title: REQ · Tick opens due SCHEDULED rounds, closes expired OPEN rounds and waits for future and COMPLETED rounds
summary: Tick acts on rounds only when the injected clock has reached their boundary
description: Context: Scheduler.Tick in backend/internal/round/scheduler.go compares clock.Now() with StartsAt for SCHEDULED rounds and EndsAt for OPEN rounds. Desired behavior: due rounds are opened or closed, while future-start, future-end and COMPLETED rounds are ignored until the boundary. Expected result: Controller receives exactly the due Open and Close calls. Why: rounds must change state at the right time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a SCHEDULED round with StartsAt 11:00 and clock 12:00, when Tick runs, then Open is called with the world ID and round ID
Given an OPEN round with EndsAt 11:59 and clock 12:00, when Tick runs, then Close is called with the world ID and round ID
Given future SCHEDULED, future OPEN and COMPLETED rounds at clock 12:00, when Tick runs, then no calls are made, and at clock 13:00 only Open and Close for the two non-COMPLETED rounds are made

in_scope: Tick switch cases on Status and clock boundary
preserve: !now.Before(boundary) comparison so the exact boundary instant counts as due

definition_of_done: Tick dispatch against the clock is confirmed in scheduler.go and covered by tests
